title: [Shopify] Base price-sync bulk threshold on changed price count
summary: Product price synchronization with Shopify now triggers bulk operations based on the count of changed variants rather than total mapped products, improving efficiency when few prices change in large catalogs.
key_points: Price sync bulk operation threshold now counts actual changed variants instead of total mapped products
UpdateProductPrice accumulates per-variant mutations and uses GraphQueryList.Count() to determine real change count
Individual synchronous mutations are sent when changes are below the 100-variant threshold instead of bulk operations
Synchronous send removed from TryFunction to enable request logging and authoritative updatedAt tracking
New unit test validates that few price changes use individual synchronous mutations without bulk operations
quote: Decide based on the actual number of changed variants instead
